game.name: BlazBlue : Calamity Trigger (USA, Japan)(En,Ja,Zh,Ko)
game.desc: BlazBlue: Calamity Trigger for Xbox 360 is a 2D fighting game considered the spiritual successor to Guilty Gear. First released in the arcade, this title revolves around an apocalyptic scenario in the year 2199. In total, Blazblue features a dozen fighters with very personal powers and abilities.
